current_grouping: Subpart D — UA Design and Construction

versions.grouping_at_time: Subpart D — UAV Design and Construction
versions.text:
(a) Movable surfaces must be installed so that there is no interference between any surfaces, their bracing or adjacent fixed structure, when one surface is held in its most critical clearance positions and the others are operated through their full movement.
(b) If an adjustable stabiliser is used, it must have stops that will limit its range of travel to that allowing safe flight and landing.
